sattva.label: Clarity & Balance
sattva.description: Calm discernment, steadiness, and grounded perspective[cite: 1, 5].
sattva.rebalance_tip: Protect quiet reflection time and simple daily structure[cite: 1, 5].

rajas.label: Momentum & Action
rajas.description: Drive, initiative, restlessness, and desire to build or change things[cite: 1, 5].
rajas.rebalance_tip: Channel active energy into clear priorities and deliberate pauses[cite: 1, 5].

tamas.label: Stillness & Inertia
tamas.description: Heaviness, resistance to change, or deep rest/withdrawal[cite: 1, 5].
tamas.rebalance_tip: Introduce gentle physical movement and small, low-friction steps[cite: 1, 5].

core_drives.dharma: Living in alignment with values, integrity, and authentic purpose[cite: 1].
core_drives.artha: Building practical capability, resources, and real-world stability[cite: 1].
core_drives.kama: Experiencing desire, affection, creativity, and life engagement[cite: 1].
core_drives.moksha: Releasing attachment, ego friction, and reactive compulsion[cite: 1].

nakshatras.name: Ashwini
nakshatras.core_impulse: Fast starts, healing energy, and quick instinctual movement.
nakshatras.strength: Decisive action and rapid recovery when starting fresh.
nakshatras.blind_spot: Rushing ahead before reading the full situation.

nakshatras.name: Bharani
nakshatras.core_impulse: Carrying weight, containment, and deep emotional endurance.
nakshatras.strength: Capacity to hold intense responsibility and see cycles through.
nakshatras.blind_spot: Carrying emotional pressure alone until reaching a breaking point.

nakshatras.name: Krittika
nakshatras.core_impulse: Sharp focus, cutting through noise, and refining what matters.
nakshatras.strength: Clear standards, decisive pruning, and strong inner determination[cite: 1].
nakshatras.blind_spot: Being overly sharp or critical when stressed.

nakshatras.name: Rohini
nakshatras.core_impulse: Nurturing growth, creativity, comfort, and steady cultivation[cite: 1].
nakshatras.strength: Ability to grow ideas, craft, and relationships into lasting form[cite: 1].
nakshatras.blind_spot: Clinging to comfort zones or over-indulging.

nakshatras.name: Mrigashira
nakshatras.core_impulse: Curiosity, searching, exploring options, and gentle inquiry[cite: 1].
nakshatras.strength: Adaptable mind that keeps learning and testing possibilities.
nakshatras.blind_spot: Restless second-guessing or scattering attention across too many options.

nakshatras.name: Ardra
nakshatras.core_impulse: Mental breakthroughs, clearing tension, and honest clarity.
nakshatras.strength: Resilience after emotional storms and sharp insight.
nakshatras.blind_spot: Internal storminess or over-analyzing conflict.

nakshatras.name: Punarvasu
nakshatras.core_impulse: Renewal, returning to center, and practical restoration[cite: 1].
nakshatras.strength: Optimistic reset after setbacks and supportive community energy[cite: 1].
nakshatras.blind_spot: Assuring everything will work out without updating habits.

nakshatras.name: Pushya
nakshatras.core_impulse: Steady nourishment, protective care, and disciplined support.
nakshatras.strength: Reliable mentorship, emotional steadiness, and long-term care.
nakshatras.blind_spot: Over-giving to others while neglecting personal boundaries.

nakshatras.name: Ashlesha
nakshatras.core_impulse: Psychological depth, sharp intuition, and protective self-containment[cite: 1].
nakshatras.strength: Reading unspoken dynamics and guarding inner autonomy[cite: 1].
nakshatras.blind_spot: Defensive secrecy or taking perceived slights deeply to heart[cite: 1].

nakshatras.name: Magha
nakshatras.core_impulse: Heritage, self-respect, dignity, and leadership presence.
nakshatras.strength: Strong sense of identity, honor, and executive direction.
nakshatras.blind_spot: Pride making it hard to ask for help or admit vulnerability.

nakshatras.name: Purva Phalguni
nakshatras.core_impulse: Warmth, enjoyment, creativity, and social connection.
nakshatras.strength: Natural charm, joy in shared experiences, and creative spark.
nakshatras.blind_spot: Seeking validation through applause or comfort.

nakshatras.name: Uttara Phalguni
nakshatras.core_impulse: Commitment, partnership reliability, and constructive agreements.
nakshatras.strength: Follow-through on promises and grounded collaboration.
nakshatras.blind_spot: Carrying unspoken resentment when others do not match effort.

nakshatras.name: Hasta
nakshatras.core_impulse: Skillful hands-on craft, precision, and practical execution.
nakshatras.strength: Attention to detail and turning plans into concrete results.
nakshatras.blind_spot: Micromanaging or over-tweaking small details.

nakshatras.name: Chitra
nakshatras.core_impulse: Design, craft, aesthetics, and structured creation.
nakshatras.strength: Eye for form, balance, and building distinctive work.
nakshatras.blind_spot: Perfectionism that delays shipping or deciding.

nakshatras.name: Swati
nakshatras.core_impulse: Independence, balance, flexibility, and calm negotiation.
nakshatras.strength: Ability to stay poised and self-directed across changing environments.
nakshatras.blind_spot: Resisting closeness when feeling pressured or boxed in.

nakshatras.name: Vishakha
nakshatras.core_impulse: Targeted focus, determination, and long-horizon achievement.
nakshatras.strength: Sustained push toward a chosen goal once committed.
nakshatras.blind_spot: Tunnel vision that overlooks relationship signals.

nakshatras.name: Anuradha
nakshatras.core_impulse: Loyalty, friendship, cooperation, and quiet devotion.
nakshatras.strength: Building enduring trust and steady alliances over time.
nakshatras.blind_spot: Holding onto hurt quietly instead of naming expectations.

nakshatras.name: Jyeshtha
nakshatras.core_impulse: Protective authority, emotional intensity, and seniority.
nakshatras.strength: Courage under pressure and sharp awareness of power dynamics.
nakshatras.blind_spot: Carrying heavy emotional armor or testing trust.

nakshatras.name: Mula
nakshatras.core_impulse: Getting to the root, truth-seeking, and fresh starts.
nakshatras.strength: Willingness to strip away illusions and rebuild from scratch.
nakshatras.blind_spot: Abruptly discarding things before letting them mature.

nakshatras.name: Purva Ashadha
nakshatras.core_impulse: Conviction, persuasion, and spirited belief.
nakshatras.strength: Confidence to rally momentum and stand behind ideas.
nakshatras.blind_spot: Over-promising or arguing a point past usefulness.

nakshatras.name: Uttara Ashadha
nakshatras.core_impulse: Enduring integrity, steady leadership, and earned respect.
nakshatras.strength: Patient consistency that holds up over years.
nakshatras.blind_spot: Rigid self-expectation and slowness to rest.

nakshatras.name: Shravana
nakshatras.core_impulse: Deep listening, learning, synthesis, and wise counsel.
nakshatras.strength: Absorbing key signals and connecting ideas thoughtfully.
nakshatras.blind_spot: Over-absorbing other people's stress or opinions.

nakshatras.name: Dhanishta
nakshatras.core_impulse: Rhythm, timing, teamwork, and resourceful momentum.
nakshatras.strength: Sense of timing and ability to coordinate group effort.
nakshatras.blind_spot: Moving too fast for slower-paced teammates or partners.

nakshatras.name: Shatabhisha
nakshatras.core_impulse: Autonomy, systems thinking, and inner boundaries.
nakshatras.strength: Originality and calm objectivity in complex situations.
nakshatras.blind_spot: Emotional detachment or feeling isolated when stressed.

nakshatras.name: Purva Bhadrapada
nakshatras.core_impulse: Transformative vision, intensity, and principled commitment.
nakshatras.strength: Passion for meaningful change and deep inner conviction.
nakshatras.blind_spot: Swinging between intense idealism and mental exhaustion.

nakshatras.name: Uttara Bhadrapada
nakshatras.core_impulse: Steady depth, patience, wisdom, and calm containment.
nakshatras.strength: Grounded emotional maturity and long-range calm.
nakshatras.blind_spot: Quietly absorbing stress or delaying action too long.

nakshatras.name: Revati
nakshatras.core_impulse: Completion, compassion, gentle transitions, and closure.
nakshatras.strength: Empathy, smooth endings, and guiding people through transitions.
nakshatras.blind_spot: Drifting or taking on ambiguity that isn't yours to carry.
